fee_notes: Royalty 5.5% of Gross Room Revenues. Marketing and Reservation Fee 3% of Gross Room Revenues (subject to increase max 5%). RediRewards Program 2% of qualifying revenue. Tech/PMS fee $490/month base plus $3.85 per room per month (subject to 5% annual increase). Numerous variable fees including booking fees ($6.60-$7.00 GDS; $3.30-$3.60 third-party internet; $1.99-$2.25 direct connect), mobile app ($1.75/booking), distribution commissions (0-25%), and optional services. Multiple conditional/performance fees for quality failures, conferences, training, and audits.
